primary.title: Section 80C deductions: Full list & the ₹1.5 Lakh limit explained (FY 2025-26)
primary.summary: Section 80C is the most used tax-saving deduction in India. It lets individuals and Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs) reduce taxable income by up to ₹1.5 lakh a year by investing in or spending on specified items — PPF, ELSS, life insurance, EPF, home loan principal, and more.
